Generic Platformer Tiles
https://opengameart.org/content/generic-platformer-tiles

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
No attribution required; attribution given here as courtesy.

generic_platformer_tiles.png is the unmodified source atlas.
All other PNGs in this folder are crops/recompositions of it:

  terrain_ground.png  96x64  9-slice, border L32 B0 R32 T32
  terrain_ledge.png   96x32  3-slice, border L32 B0 R32 T0
  terrain_wall.png    96x32  3-slice, border L32 B0 R32 T0
  tree_big / tree_small / bush / grass_tuft / flower /
  mushroom_small / mushroom_big / cloud   - straight crops

Import settings are applied by Assets/Scripts/Editor/TerrainArtUpgrade.cs
(32 PPU, point filter, FullRect mesh, uncompressed).
